race.comment: SNOW EAGLE (4) improved from a modest effort fresh at Launceston to finishing a head back in second there 12 days ago. She has done all of her best racing on this track, and looks primed to go one better. KION'S KINGDOM (1) is a lightly tried 5YO who was too slick off the top at Launceston last time out, scoring his maiden win by a length. He has placed in his only start here, and will again take plenty of pegging back. TOORAK LAD (2) won his maiden easily at Launceston 3 starts back, and his 2 starts since then have been hampered by wide draws. He gets a superior gate this time, and is ready to bounce back into form. Each way. PACIFIC WITNESS (5) flipped her form around by causing a massive upset when winning here over the top pick by a head. She has every chance to repeat the dose, but don't expect another fancy price. STRATOJACK (6) resumes from a spell with a quiet trial under his belt. Let the market be the best guide.
